hook: An Australian photographer's Stolen Generations portraits are on show at *Indian Photo Festival*
hook_b: An Australian photographer's Stolen Generations portraits are on show at *Indian Photo Festival*
tldr: Tace Stevens' project 'We Were Just Little Boys', on men taken from their families as children, is showing at the Indian Photo Festival in Hyderabad.

beats.what: 'We Were Just Little Boys' pairs portraits of survivors of Kinchela Boys Home with archival photos and their handwritten testimonies.
beats.why: The Stolen Generations were indigenous children forcibly removed from families under Australian policies, mainly 1910 to the 1970s.
beats.care: It is Stevens' first visit to India; the project was made at the request of a survivor-led organisation.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The project was commissioned by the Magnum Foundation and World Monuments Fund.

cards.q: Would you go see a photo exhibition on history like this?

qs: What other international projects are at this year's festival?

facts.t: Stevens visited the Kinchela site at least *10* times, about four and a half hours north of Sydney.

viz.verdict: A history project from Australia, shown in Hyderabad.

watch: The project is on show at the Indian Photo Festival in Hyderabad.
